amends: configs/benchmark_resource_protocol_v2.json (SHA-256 0981d6b61985d5d9169e601f76aea0c27f00ca9ee740b4ee9ded6c8cef6e0234), caller_panels.*_nonvoting, and the readiness requirement that every listed caller be ready
timing: Before any extension input is staged, any extension caller is run, or any extension truth is joined. See reports/extension_readiness_assessment_20261009.md.
change: The confirmatory extension requires, runs and reports only the voting panels: WES HLA-HD, OptiType, POLYSOLVER, SpecHLA, T1K; RNA-seq ArcasHLA, HLA-HD, OptiType, T1K. The non-voting comparators (HLA*LA, Kourami, HISAT-genotype, seq2HLA) are removed from the extension and from its readiness requirement.
unchanged: primary method (SimplePluralityLex, equal weights, lexicographic tie-break, native-declaration singleton rule)
primary endpoint and secondary endpoints computed from the voting panels
inference (subject bootstrap, subject sign-flip, Holm within assay; non-inferiority post hoc sensitivity only)
all other blocking gates, including the clean immutable public release with DOI
rationale: The non-voting comparators feed no primary or confirmatory quantity. HISAT-genotype has no container or database at all, so requiring it would block the confirmatory test for descriptive comparators only. The only extension output removed is the descriptive 'caller database representability' rows for those four callers.
implementation: configs/caller_resources_v2.json marks the four with extension_required=false and this decision; readiness.audit_extension_readiness skips callers so marked and records them as excluded.
